notes: Two sources only, both ESPEC North America (snapshots research/v5/cache/c98e1451f190c129.txt = model page, research/v5/cache/d57669701effc740.txt = Platinous J brochure Feb 2026). Exterior dimensions disagree slightly: model page 973 x 1220 x 1930 mm vs brochure 973 x 1184 x 1934 mm; the model page (catalog primary document) values are used. Floor-standing stainless box cabinet on heavy-duty casters with one front door; stainless workspace 500 x 600 x 750 mm (225 L) with rounded corners and one wire shelf. Thermal system per brochure cutaway (p.3): a blower at the rear recirculates air across a cooling coil, heaters and an in-chamber heated humidity bath (labels: 'Test Area, Blower, Heaters, Cooling Coil, Humidity Bath, Air Flow'); mechanical refrigeration with electronic expansion valves, no cryogen in standard configuration (LN2 boost is an unfitted option). -70 to 180 C, 10-98 %RH, 6 C/min heating, 4 C/min cooling, 400 CFM, 208/230 V 3ph 40 A, 25,000 BTU/h heat to room, 76 dBA. No vacuum, no magnet. Standard configuration has no window (viewing window option 9 x 10.3 in not fitted); the only sample pass-through is a single 4 in cable port centred in the left wall with two flexible plugs. For the 3D model: box with front door, conditioning plenum (blower, heaters, coil, humidity bath) behind/above the test area, air circulating through the workspace, a 4 in round port on the left wall, 10-inch touchscreen GL controller on the cabinet, 1/2 in condensate drain hose. Refrigeration machinery is below the workspace behind hinged service panels (height not published).
